name: Knowledge in the Deeps
summary: In Ironforge, Gerrig Bonegrip sends you across the sea to seek an ancient manuscript. He wants the Lorgalis Manuscript from the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale.

sections.title: A Scholar in the Shadows
sections.body:
In Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern, Gerrig Bonegrip gathers ancient texts. His interests reach beyond ordinary histories and civic records. He seeks forgotten lore that can open doorways and awaken 'Those Who Sleep.'

Bonegrip speaks of surviving beyond 'the end days.' Such words make him seem either an eccentric scholar or a devotee of powers that slumber in shadow.

sections.title: The Sunken Ruin of Lorgalis
sections.body:
Bonegrip sends you to Ashenvale's shadowed shores, where the night elven sanctuary of Blackfathom Deeps lies drowned. Before the Great Sundering tore Kalimdor apart, night elven scholars gathered great magical knowledge in coastal temples.

Now naga, satyrs, and Twilight's Hammer cultists crawl through the flooded halls. Among them lies the Lorgalis Manuscript, forbidden lore kept in a Pitted Iron Chest.

sections.title: Brothers and Sisters
sections.body:
When Gerrig Bonegrip receives the watersoaked manuscript, he does not take it to Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. He rejoices that copies will be made and shared with his mysterious 'brothers and sisters.'

He thanks the Alliance adventurer who recovered it, yet his loyalties lie with a hidden sect eager to use the lore in rites that could change the world. Bonegrip is tied to the Twilight's Hammer, whose followers seek forbidden knowledge of the Old Gods.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Knowledge in the Deeps?
aliases: who starts knowledge in the deeps
faq.answer: Gerrig Bonegrip gives the request. He is a dwarf who seeks lore and lives in Forlorn Cavern, within Ironforge.
The Lorgalis Manuscript is a text Gerrig Bonegrip wants recovered from Blackfathom Deeps. It lies in a Pitted Iron Chest among the flooded ruins.

faq.q: Where is the Lorgalis Manuscript located?
aliases: where is the book in bfd
faq.answer: The Lorgalis Manuscript lies deep inside Blackfathom Deeps, along the Zoram Strand on Ashenvale's northwestern coast in Kalimdor.

faq.q: Who are 'Those Who Sleep' mentioned by Gerrig Bonegrip?
faq.answer: Bonegrip uses 'Those Who Sleep' for the slumbering powers described in the forbidden lore he collects.

faq.q: Who are the 'brothers and sisters' Gerrig plans to share the manuscript with?
faq.answer: Bonegrip's associates share his interest in forbidden lore. Recovering the manuscript can reveal more about whom he serves.

faq.q: Why does a quest in Ironforge send players all the way to Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern draws unsanctioned magic users, warlocks, and rogues seeking secrets hidden from the light. Bonegrip gathers old, powerful lore, and the Lorgalis Manuscript he seeks is said to lie beneath Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale, the old home of long-dead elves who held great knowledge.

angles.text: In Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern, Bonegrip works alongside warlocks who hide there. He shares their hunger for forbidden texts that bend the planes.
The manuscript lies in Blackfathom Deeps, a drowned night elven sanctuary now occupied by cultists and other intruders.
Helping an Alliance scholar seems harmless, but Bonegrip's motives and shadowy associates point to darker designs within Ironforge's walls.
